# Generated by pyke from inkwell.pyke - do not edit, changes will be overwritten.

add_executable(wb_tests)
target_link_libraries(wb_tests PRIVATE wb_core)
target_link_libraries(wb_tests PRIVATE GTest::gtest_main)

file(GLOB_RECURSE wb_tests_SOURCES_0 CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "src/*.cpp"
)
target_sources(wb_tests PRIVATE ${wb_tests_SOURCES_0})
target_compile_options(wb_tests PRIVATE "$<$<BOOL:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>>:/W4>")
target_compile_options(wb_tests PRIVATE "$<$<BOOL:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU,Clang,AppleClang>>:-Wall;-Wextra;-Wpedantic>")
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(wb_tests PRIVATE
        "/utf-8"
        "/permissive-"
        "/Zc:preprocessor"
        "/Zc:__cplusplus"
        "/MP"
    )
endif()
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    target_compile_options(wb_tests PRIVATE
        "-Wno-missing-designated-field-initializers"
    )
endif()

get_target_property(wb_tests_ALL_SOURCES wb_tests SOURCES)
if(wb_tests_ALL_SOURCES)
    foreach(_src IN LISTS wb_tests_ALL_SOURCES)
        cmake_path(ABSOLUTE_PATH _src BASE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} NORMALIZE OUTPUT_VARIABLE _abs)
        cmake_path(IS_PREFIX CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR "${_abs}" NORMALIZE _inside)
        if(_inside)
            source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES "${_abs}")
        else()
            source_group("External Sources" FILES "${_abs}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

add_test(NAME wb_tests COMMAND wb_tests)

if(WIN32)
    add_custom_command(TARGET wb_tests POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E $<IF:$<BOOL:$<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:wb_tests>>,copy_if_different,true>
            $<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:wb_tests>
            $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:wb_tests>
        COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
    )
endif()
